reasoning: This workflow implements a lottery win notification system for FairTix, a ticket platform that positions itself as 'fair queue' anti-bot ticketing. When a new entry is added to the 'LotteryWins' sheet, it triggers automated winner notifications via Gmail. The elaborate email template reveals FairTix's brand positioning - transparent pricing, no hidden fees, verified humans only. The workflow includes proper error handling with separate success/error tracking back to the sheet using status codes (200/500) and error messages. The system polls every minute, suggesting high-frequency lottery draws or continuous winner selection. The 24-hour purchase window mentioned in emails indicates a time-sensitive revenue conversion mechanism.
name: FairTix Lottery Winner Notification System
businessNarrative: This workflow powers FairTix's winner notification process for their fair queue ticket lottery system. When winners are selected and added to a tracking spreadsheet, it automatically sends beautifully designed congratulatory emails with purchase links and transparent pricing details. The system reinforces FairTix's brand promise of 'no hidden fees' and 'verified humans only' while creating urgency with 24-hour purchase windows. This is a critical revenue conversion touchpoint that transforms lottery selections into ticket sales.
trigger: New lottery winner entry added to Google Sheets tracking spreadsheet
dataFlow: Lottery winner data (Name, Email, EventName, TicketPrice, ID) flows from spreadsheet to Gmail for notification emails, then status updates (200/500 codes, messages, timestamps) flow back to spreadsheet for tracking.

impact.reasoning: This is revenue-critical because it's the primary mechanism converting lottery selections to ticket sales. Failed notifications mean lost revenue and poor customer experience for winners who don't know they won. The 24-hour purchase window creates urgency - if winners don't receive notifications, seats are released and revenue is lost.
impact.failureScenario: Winners don't receive notifications, miss 24-hour purchase windows, tickets are released to others, direct revenue loss and customer complaints about missing notifications.
impact.revenueConnection: Direct - converts lottery wins to ticket purchases within 24-hour windows. Data-driven.

detectability.reasoning: Has built-in error tracking with separate success/error update nodes that write status codes and error messages back to the spreadsheet, providing audit trail and failure visibility.
detectability.evidence: Error update node writes 500 status codes and error messages to spreadsheet, but no external alerting or automated retry mechanisms.

stepName: Winner notification and purchase conversion trigger
timeSavingsEstimate: 5-10 minutes per winner notification (manual email drafting, personalization, tracking). At scale with frequent lotteries, could save hours daily. Benchmark-based.

technicalEvidence.errorHandling: Gmail node has 'continueErrorOutput' setting, routing errors to Error update node. No retryOnFail enabled on any nodes.
credentials: DL School Automations Google Sheets Account (googleSheetsTriggerOAuth2Api)
technicalEvidence.complexity: 4 nodes with conditional branching, rich HTML email template, spreadsheet update tracking
keyFindings: Every-minute polling suggests high-frequency lottery operations
Sophisticated email template reveals premium ticket platform positioning
Status code tracking (200/500) indicates enterprise-grade operational monitoring
24-hour purchase window creates revenue urgency mechanism
